newsitem.title: USA: SunRiver Corp acting CEO Mackenzie resigns.
newsitem.headline: SunRiver Corp acting CEO Mackenzie resigns.

text.p: SunRiver Corp said Thursday it named J. Gerald Combs chairman and chief executive, replacing acting chairman and CEO Leonard Mackenzie.
The company said Mackenzie resigned to pursue opportunities in another industry.
The company said Combs is also chairman and CEO of privately held SunRiver Group Inc, which owns about 53 percent of the issued and outstanding shares of SunRiver Corp.
The company said he will continue to work from SunRiver Group's office in New York.
Mackenzie was named acting chairman and CEO in November, after Gerald Youngblood resigned when SunRiver Group sought his departure and several other management changes.
